text: Acceptance evidence: FeatureMatrix.sparseRow is CSR-row-sized (one stored value on a one-million-column regression); SampleIndex lookup is hash-indexed; WLCompiledKernel.query returns sparse aligned and cross rows; randomized directed oracles match batch bit-for-bit and joint recompilation to 1e-12; 1000 queries preserve dictionary/fingerprint/Gram/row; novel norm remains separate. Full engine 144/144 and worker 16/16 pass. Scaling receipt benchmarks 10k 20-vertex queries against 5k training graphs/F=15k in 0.472 s, 47.2 us/query, 77.8 KB mean thread allocation/query; it caught and removed a prior F-sized 1.85 MB/query allocation. Report: benchmarks/court/reports/2026-08-28-query-overlay.md.
